projectExplanation.title: How I Built This
projectExplanation.content:
This project is built using React for the frontend and Node/Express for the backend. I wanted to create something that is fast, clean, and easy to update.

### 1. Separate Frontend & Backend
The code for the UI and the server are kept in different folders. This way, the frontend just asks the server for the data it needs using Axios.

### 2. Flexible Data Handling
I use both MongoDB and local JSON files. This ensures the site works even if the database has a connection issue.

### 3. Fast Loading
I designed the site to load the most important information first, so it feels fast and responsive.
